model: Direct-Fired Make-Up Air MCV/MVV, DCV/DVV (Distech ECB/ECL-403)
applies_to: Modine MCV/MVV and DCV/DVV direct-fired make-up air units with model digit 14 = L or M and the Distech ECB/ECL-403 controller.
summary: These Modine direct-fired make-up air units use a Distech ECB-403 programmable controller that joins a BACnet MS/TP trunk. The BMS can turn the unit fan on, off or auto, write occupied and unoccupied heat and cool setpoints, set the building pressure setpoint and economizer commands, and override space temperature, building pressure and occupancy with network values. Alarms (dirty filter, low temperature, sensor faults, burner lockout, motor not responding) are multistate values.
notes: The manual calls Table 11.1 'typical' system variables; units with LonTalk (model digit 14 = L) need factory guidance.
Cooling-related points (cool setpoints, HeatCoolMode, CoolLockout) only apply to units with the cooling option; HeatVentMode applies to units without it.
network_SpaceTemperature, network_BuildingPressure and network_Occupancy override local values; write null (relinquish) to return to automatic control.
network_ManualEconPercent is not available with the building pressure option.
The enumeration texts for the Filters and SensorReliability state sets are not printed in the BACnet table; the display menu shows the sensor alarms as no-fault / open / short.

source.title: Programmable Controller User Manual - Direct Fired Makeup Air Units, models MCV/MVV, DCV/DVV (Distech Controls)

integration.summary: Set the MAC address on the controller DIP switches; the device instance follows as 364000 + MAC and the baud rate is auto-detected. Start and stop the unit with network_FanCommand (AV 103), write the occupied heat setpoint (AV 102) and, if fitted, the building pressure setpoint. Monitor discharge and space temperature, the heat command and the alarm multistates.

minimum_points.name: network_FanCommand
minimum_points.why: Unit fan command: 0 = off, 1 = on, 2 = auto

minimum_points.name: network_Occupancy
minimum_points.why: Occupancy override, 0 = occ, 1 = unocc; null = schedule

minimum_points.name: network_BuildingPressSetPoint
minimum_points.why: Building pressure setpoint, -0.1 to 0.1 in. w.c.

integration.enable: The unit runs when enabled by the BMS through network_FanCommand (AV 103), by a contact closure on digital input DI-5, or by its internal schedule. network_Occupancy (AV 134) overrides schedule occupancy; write null to give control back.
integration.remote_sensors: network_SpaceTemperature (AV 132) and network_BuildingPressure (AV 133) replace the local sensor readings while written; write null to return to the local sensors.
setup: MAC address is set in binary on the 8 controller DIP switches (switch 1 = LSB); each unit ships with a unique MAC.
Device instance = 364 x 1000 + MAC; change the MAC to clear a duplicate instance.
Baud rate is auto-detected after a power cycle.
The manual recommends starting MAC addresses at 3.
gotchas: The override points stay in force until the BMS writes null; a left-over value freezes the reading.
network_ManualEconPercent does nothing on units with the building pressure option.
Cooling points only apply to units built with cooling.
A low temperature shutdown is reset by setting the fan command to off and then back on.
